title: Isn't about "fake news" or "memes" or "viral" when you starve children of tools for literacy you should not be surprised when they grow up illiterate
summary: Isn't about "fake news" or "memes" or "viral" when you starve children of tools for literacy you should not be surprised when they grow up illiterate (though data shows its our parents doing most of the spreading), we never gave tools to read and write web #web30
